<issue>
Section iteration returns incorrect content across document sections

#### Description

When iterating through inner content of document sections using `iter_inner_content()`, the method returns incorrect paragraphs and tables. The content from different sections gets mixed up, with some sections showing content that belongs to other sections.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Load a document with multiple sections
document = Document('sct-inner-content.docx')

# Check the sections
print(f"Number of sections: {len(document.sections)}")

# Iterate through first section - should contain P1, T2, P3
section_0_content = list(document.sections[0].iter_inner_content())
print(f"Section 0 content count: {len(section_0_content)}")
for i, item in enumerate(section_0_content):
    if hasattr(item, 'text'):
        print(f"  Item {i}: {item.text}")
    elif hasattr(item, 'rows'):
        print(f"  Item {i}: Table with {item.rows[0].cells[0].text}")

# Iterate through second section - should contain T4, P5, P6  
section_1_content = list(document.sections[1].iter_inner_content())
print(f"Section 1 content count: {len(section_1_content)}")
for i, item in enumerate(section_1_content):
    if hasattr(item, 'text'):
        print(f"  Item {i}: {item.text}")
    elif hasattr(item, 'rows'):
        print(f"  Item {i}: Table with {item.rows[0].cells[0].text}")
```

The iteration returns content that doesn't match the expected section boundaries, with paragraphs and tables appearing in the wrong sections.
